title: GM aims to develop vehicles in as little as two years with AI, software push
hook_text: GM wants cars in two years
script:
General Motors is aiming to develop new vehicles in as little as two years.
The automaker is relying on a major push into software and AI to hit that timeline.
Traditional vehicle development typically takes four to five years across the industry.
General Motors hopes this new strategy will drastically speed up vehicle creation and design.
Would you buy a car designed in two years?

editor.one_line: Strong topic and clear numbers, but visual monotony and repetitive phrasing drag it down.
script_fixes: LINE 2: Replace 'The automaker is relying on' with 'GM is leveraging generative AI and digital design tools.'
LINE 4: Replace 'General Motors hopes this new strategy will drastically speed up vehicle creation and design.' with 'The push aims to slash engineering bottlenecks and accelerate production cycles.'
visual_notes: line 1: Holds the same plain title card for too long across multiple frames.
line 2: Reuses the exact same text-highlight visual from previous lines, causing visual fatigue.
line 3: Holds the '5 yrs' graphic statically for too many frames without motion or variation.
